description: AAASM-5344: clean mixed zh-TW / English agent traffic — no findings. This is the shape real payloads take: ASCII identifiers and log keywords interleaved with space-less Chinese. The Chinese request clause is 51 bytes at 4.80 bits/byte — inside the window and over the gate — while every ASCII run in the line stays short and low-entropy, so the whole line must scan clean and only does so if each token is scored per ASCII run rather than whole.
